title: JSFL: element.getBounds() and element.colorEffect read/write
description:
Two JSFL element proxy fixes in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts:

1. element.getBounds(): not in the Proxy get trap. Flash 8 JSFL exposes element.getBounds(objSpaceOrDocSpace?) returning {left, top, right, bottom}. Add a 'getBounds' case to the get trap in makeElementProxy (near getTransformationPoint, around line 341). For shape objects: compute bounds from shape paths (min/max of all path coordinates, offset by x/y). For SymbolInstances: use {left: obj.x, top: obj.y, right: obj.x + naturalWidth, bottom: obj.y + naturalHeight} or similar. The parameter objSpaceOrDocSpace can default to false (document space = just return the actual coords).

2. element.colorEffect read/write: the get trap falls through to Reflect.get() which returns the raw ColorEffect model object ({type:'tint', tintColor:'#ff0000', tintAmount:50}) but Flash 8 JSFL expects a string like 'tint', 'brightness', 'alpha', 'advanced', or 'none'. Add a 'colorEffect' case to the get trap that maps the model to the string, and a setter case that accepts a string (like 'tint') or the full object (for scripts that set colorEffect directly).

Both fixes go in makeElementProxy's get (and set for colorEffect) trap. Run tests after: pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run (must stay at 612).
